name: Concord Medical Co., Ltd.
summary: Concord Medical Co., Ltd. delivers extensive support services for hospital administration across Taiwan, Myanmar, and China. The company's portfolio of services includes critical medical management assistance, covering professional training for healthcare staff, the provision of nursing personnel, and general operational guidance. Additionally, Concord Medical offers comprehensive procurement solutions, sourcing a broad spectrum of items such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, general medical supplies and consumables, as well as specialized inspection equipment and laboratory reagents. Expanding its ventures, the firm also develops and markets its own proprietary brands, which feature aesthetic healthcare products, nutritional supplements, and prepared traditional Chinese medicines. Furthermore, Concord Medical is actively involved in the strategic planning and sales of medical equipment, alongside offering medical apparatus leasing services. Concord Medical Co., Ltd. was established in 2009 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
